questions.q: I use an app ___ translates restaurant menus from a photo.
questions.explainRo: Pentru lucruri (an app) folosim which (sau that).

questions.q: Our client is in New York, so the ___ makes calls difficult: when it's 6 p.m. here, it's 11 a.m. there.
questions.explainRo: „time difference” = diferența de fus orar dintre două locuri.

questions.q: These days I ___ work from a café near my flat — it's quieter than the office.
questions.explainRo: Pentru obiceiuri din prezent folosim usually; used to este doar pentru trecut.

questions.q: My sister keeps ___ me when I'm going to visit her in Madrid.
questions.explainRo: După keep folosim forma -ing: keeps asking.

questions.q: Our team leader, ___ lives in Berlin, works with us remotely.
questions.explainRo: Informație în plus, între virgule, despre o persoană → who (niciodată that).

questions.q: My brother has lived ___ for ten years — first in Italy, and now in Canada.
We look forward to ___ (work) with you on the new project.
questions.explainRo: În „look forward to”, „to” este prepoziție, deci urmează -ing.

questions.q: After a year in London, I still haven't got used to ___ (drive) on the left.
questions.explainRo: „get used to” (a se obișnui cu) este urmat de -ing.

questions.ro: Colegul care a găsit bug-ul este în concediu.
questions.explainRo: Pentru persoane folosim who: the colleague who…

questions.ro: Plănuiesc să vizitez Japonia la primăvară.
questions.explainRo: După plan folosim to + verb: planning to visit.

questions.audio: The tram we took was full of tourists.
answers: The tram we took was full of tourists.
questions.ro: Tramvaiul cu care am mers era plin de turiști.
questions.explainRo: Pronumele relativ poate lipsi când nu este subiect: the tram (that) we took.

questions.ro: Pe vremuri plăteam o chirie foarte mare.
answers: I used to pay a very high rent.
I used to pay very high rent.
I used to pay a really high rent.
I used to pay really high rent.
I used to pay a lot of rent.
I used to pay a lot for rent.
We used to pay a very high rent.
We used to pay very high rent.
We used to pay a really high rent.
We used to pay really high rent.
We used to pay a lot of rent.
We used to pay a lot for rent.
My rent used to be very high.
Our rent used to be very high.
questions.explainRo: „Pe vremuri” + un obicei din trecut = used to + verb.
